# NeuroChem

> Interactive anatomical human brain pharmacokinetics explorer in Three.js. Drop and combine 10 neuroactive compounds onto a segmented human brain to watch where they act, how they spread, live synaptic neuro-reactions, and their 0h-to-years timeline.

## Links

- [Live App](https://h3manth.com/fun/neurochem/): Interactive WebGL brain with URL state (`?compound=caffeine,theanine&phase=2`).
- [Full Pharmacology Reference](https://h3manth.com/fun/neurochem/llms-full.txt): Complete 10-compound pharmacokinetics, 5-stage timelines, target structures, and interaction rules.
- [A2A Agent Card](https://h3manth.com/fun/neurochem/agent-card.json): Machine-readable WebMCP tool schemas.
- [Source Code](https://github.com/hemanth/neurochem): MIT licensed static web app.

## WebMCP & Browser Agent API (`navigator.modelContext` / `window.neurochem`)

- `select_compounds({ compounds, phase })`: Select or combine up to 4 compounds (`ssri`, `snri`, `caffeine`, `theanine`, `creatine`, `stimulant`, `psilocybin`, `magnesium`, `ketamine`, `lithium`) and set phase `0..4`.
- `set_timeline_phase({ phase })`: Jump to `0` (0h Ingestion), `1` (1h Early), `2` (Peak Tmax), `3` (t1/2 Clearance), or `4` (Years Chronic).
- `focus_brain_region({ region })`: Smoothly rotate camera to `pfc`, `raphe`, `locus`, `hippocampus`, `amygdala`, `striatum`, `thalamus`, or `cerebellum`.
- `check_stack_interaction({ compounds })`: Return synergy or clinical caution notes for a stack.
- `list_compounds()`: Return all 10 compounds with half-life, Tmax, target structures, and molecular reaction equations.
